title: The objectwise cone diagram and augmented cocone
statement: Let I be a preorder and A a preadditive category with binary biproducts. For D,E:I→CochainComplex(A,Int) and a natural transformation φ:D→E, form the diagram with value mappingCone(φ(i)) and maps mappingCone.map. Given cocones c on D and e on E, an arrow f:c.pt→e.pt, and equalities φ(i);e(i)=c(i);f, mappingCone.map gives a cocone on this diagram with vertex mappingCone(f). These are the actual cone diagram and cocone used in the total bar [def-sc-preorder-bar-total].

source.place: The source-bar, least-block unit contraction, and finite-cone-block paragraphs.

proof.text: At i use mappingCone(φ(i)), and on i→j use mappingCone.map for the naturality square. The identity and composition laws follow from mappingCone.map_id and map_comp. On the cocone use mappingCone.map for the supplied compatible square. Cocone naturality follows from map_comp and the two original cocone equations.
